technique_name: Explain the series of events leading up to the fall of the Roman Empire.
description: The fall of the Roman Empire was the result of a complex series of factors, including economic decline, military overstretch, political corruption and internal divisions, and the influx of barbarian people. Over several centuries these issues eroded the power of the Roman Empire and ultimately led to its fall in the 5th century CE.
